decisions.reason: Changing the issue month from December to November does not alter the white-space or filler-image rules; the same-message image-placement instruction is already represented independently.
The issue-month change does not alter author-name, author-photo, source, matching, or placement requirements.
The polished, modern, Civic Lantern-aligned visual style remains valid unchanged for the issue.
Changing the issue month does not modify the requirement to enhance low-quality publication images when necessary.
The Civic Lantern website remains the article-content source regardless of the corrected issue month.
The month correction does not change the requirement for creation of the magazine layout template.
Advertisement clarity and rendering-quality requirements remain unchanged by the issue-month correction.
The source changes the issue month, not any article category, category mapping, label style, or label placement.
The specified cover-mentioned articles remain required and their placement rules are unaffected by the issue month.
The issue-month correction does not resolve or modify the free-platform and white-label branding requirements.
The supplied-content assembly behavior and Flat Plan reference remain valid unchanged for the November issue.
The tribute page remains required toward the end of the magazine regardless of the corrected issue month.
